summary: TeraWulf filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary DB Long Hunts Data LLC executed amended and restated transmission and energy service agreements with Kentucky Power on October 1, 2026, expanding contracted capacity at the Muskie Data Campus from 500 MW to 1 GW and pulling the second 500 MW phase forward from 2030 to 2029, subject to Kentucky Public Service Commission approval. The company also disclosed intent to upsize its senior secured revolver and raise additional senior secured debt for letter-of-credit needs. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, price, premium, or deal terms were stated. This is a routine power-contract and financing update, not a special situation; watch utility approval timing and financing execution risk.
